vehicle_physical_button_press_zty.goal: Activate the front-windshield defogger with one quick tap.
vehicle_physical_button_press_zty.desc: Demonstrate brief activation of the windshield-clearing control, identified by the heated curved-glass symbol.
vehicle_physical_button_press_zty.steps: step1: find the front-windshield defogger control; step2: center the index fingertip over its surface; step3: deliver one short tap without holding; step4: lift the finger clear and withdraw the hand;

vehicle_physical_button_press_zty.goal: Decrease only the driver's climate temperature by one increment.
vehicle_physical_button_press_zty.desc: Demonstrate a single adjustment to the driver's independent temperature zone while avoiding the fan and passenger controls.
vehicle_physical_button_press_zty.steps: step1: locate the driver-zone temperature-down button; step2: approach it with the fingertip aligned to the center; step3: make one discrete press to lower the setting; step4: release immediately and move away;

vehicle_physical_button_press_zty.goal: Reduce cabin blower speed by one level using the fan-minus control.
vehicle_physical_button_press_zty.desc: Demonstrate lowering airflow intensity rather than changing either occupant's temperature setting.
vehicle_physical_button_press_zty.steps: step1: identify the control that decreases fan output; step2: position the fingertip squarely above that control; step3: tap once to reduce blower speed one step; step4: remove contact and retreat;

vehicle_physical_button_press_zty.goal: Lower the front passenger's climate temperature by one increment.
vehicle_physical_button_press_zty.desc: Demonstrate a one-step change to the front-passenger climate zone while leaving the driver's setting untouched.
vehicle_physical_button_press_zty.steps: step1: find the passenger-zone temperature-decrease control; step2: guide the fingertip to its center without contacting nearby buttons; step3: press exactly once; step4: release and return the hand to a safe pose;

vehicle_physical_button_press_zty.goal: Hold the trunk-release control until the tailgate begins to open.
vehicle_physical_button_press_zty.desc: Demonstrate the sustained trunk-opening command; success is indicated by the rear tailgate starting to move.
vehicle_physical_button_press_zty.steps: step1: locate the trunk-release switch; step2: establish firm fingertip contact; step3: maintain continuous pressure instead of tapping; step4: wait for the tailgate to begin opening; step5: release the switch and pull the hand back;

vehicle_physical_button_press_zty.goal: Start opening the panoramic-roof sunshade with one short press.
vehicle_physical_button_press_zty.desc: Demonstrate a single-tap roof-sunshade command: release the control immediately after activation instead of holding it down.
vehicle_physical_button_press_zty.steps: step1: identify the panoramic-roof sunshade-open control; step2: align the fingertip with its center; step3: press once and release immediately; step4: confirm that the overhead shade starts retracting; step5: move the hand clear;

vehicle_physical_button_press.goal: Press the front windshield defrost button once.
vehicle_physical_button_press.desc: Collect a demonstration for the in-car physical button task: front windshield defrost.
vehicle_physical_button_press.steps: step1: move the dexterous hand to the target button; step2: align the fingertip with the button surface; step3: press the button once; step4: release the button; step5: return to a safe pose;
